-- Phase 2: bodies implemented. Signatures and contracts are unchanged.

type NoteError = { name: str }

-- True only for a plain file name: no separators, no "..", no absolute paths.
safe_name(name: str) -> bool =
  post out == False or (name.split("/").len() == 1 and name.split("\\").len() == 1 and name.split("..").len() == 1)
  ex safe_name("a.txt") == True
  ex safe_name("../secret") == False
  name.split("/").len() == 1 and name.split("\\").len() == 1 and name.split("..").len() == 1

-- Reads notes/name. Missing or unreadable gives "". Only safe names reach the read.
read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  pre safe_name(name)
  post out.char_count() >= 0
  ex read_note("missing.txt") == ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    fs.read(name) else ""

-- Counts names that are readable notes. Unsafe names are never opened.
-- Note: an existing empty file reads as "" and so is not counted.
count_readable(names: List[str]) -> int uses fs =
  post out >= 0 and out <= names.len()
  ex count_readable([]) == 0
  ex count_readable(["../secret", "missing.txt"]) == 0
  var n = 0
  for name in names
    if safe_name(name)
      if read_note(name) != ""
        n += 1
  n
